A download server can no longer put a file outside the download folder.

## 🔒 Security

- **A download server can no longer put a file outside the download folder.** When the file name it sent in the Content-Disposition header, or at the end of the link, had a path in it, KnightLoader kept the path. A server could use that to overwrite or delete a file elsewhere on the disk, create folders there, or find out whether a file exists. Only the last part of such a name counts now, and names from resolvers, link containers and torrents are cut down the same way. Names saved by an earlier version are cut down when KnightLoader starts.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A settings address that names no page shows the empty page.** An address such as `#/settings/constructor` broke the settings page instead of saying that there is nothing there.
